title: SDTS vocabulary overlay (<name>.sdvo.yaml)
description: GENERATED by scripts/gen_overlay_schema.py from schemas/sdvo.schema.json.in + data/vocabulary/manifest.yaml - DO NOT EDIT. A per-deployment or per-DJ customization applied over the immutable SDTS baseline vocabulary. The vocabulary sections add or remove aliases and terms, keyed by dimension (read by SocialDanceVocabulary.LoadOverlay, written by SaveOverlay). A full personal profile ALSO carries read-time rules that never touch a canonical value or the stable hash: cross_dimension (a value in one dimension projects onto another), colors (per-value chip colour/label, presentation only), and from_path (filename/path projection onto SDTS fields); these are read by LoadProfile, written by SaveProfile. The baseline is never mutated (With()/WithProfile() return a NEW vocabulary). The dimension enums track vocabulary_version, NOT schemaVersion - adding a core dimension regenerates this schema at the same schemaVersion. INVARIANTS JSON SCHEMA CANNOT EXPRESS, enforced in dotnet/src/SocialDanceTaggingStandard.Taxonomy/SocialDanceVocabulary.cs after schema validation: (1) an add_aliases term key must match a term by id, canonical, or an existing alias, else it is a silent no-op; (2) remove_terms is applied before add_terms; (3) add_terms on the 'dances' dimension is ignored - packs are applied with allowAddTerms:false, so a new dance needs its own pack.

schemaVersion.description: Format shape version. v0 (unversioned) = the pre-format shape; v1 added the version field and modeline; v2 added the personal-profile rule sections (cross_dimension, colors, from_path). A file written before this format existed carries no schemaVersion and is read as legacy v0, then migrated forward on load. A version higher than the loader knows is rejected outright, never partially read - so an older overlay-only reader refuses a v2 profile rather than silently dropping its rules.

sdts_vocabulary.description: Advisory only: the vocabulary_version this overlay was authored against. Never normative - the overlay is applied whatever the baseline version is.

owner.description: Advisory only: whose overlay this is.

description.description: Advisory only: a free-text note for whoever edits this file next.

dimensionName.description: A core dimension id, or "dances" - the virtual cross-pack dimension, whose ops fan out to every enabled pack.

coreDimensionName.description: add_terms is core-only. SocialDanceVocabulary.With applies packs with allowAddTerms:false, so a "dances" key here would be a SILENT no-op; add a custom pack for a new dance instead.

nonEmptyStrings.description: MUST be a sequence. A bare scalar (dances: "#LH") is the commonest hand-edit mistake and parses to a silent no-op in a pre-schema loader.

aliasAdditions.description: dimension -> term (id, canonical, or an existing alias) -> aliases to add. This is how a deployment restores personal shorthand the baseline does not carry, including on pack dance terms.

customTerm.description: A new deployment-owned term. additionalProperties is INTENTIONAL: a term may carry dimension attributes (family, tempo_min, ...) that are preserved verbatim as VocabularyTerm.Attributes but are not schema-validated here.

canonical.description: The only string StableHash ever sees.

code.description: A short code. Codes resolve as first-class tokens, so keep it unique within the dimension.

crossDimensionRules.description: Per-DJ cross-dimension ingest rules: a value in one dimension projects onto another (e.g. genre 'Slovenian' -> artist_country 'SI'). Resolved ABOVE the sync layer, so a rule never alters a canonical that reaches the stable hash.

keep_source.description: Keep the source value as well as projecting it (default true). Omitted when true.

migrate.description: Whether IngestMapper.PlanMigration emits a rewrite for this rule (default false). Omitted when false.

match.description: How from_value is compared (default CaseInsensitive). Omitted when default.

colorOverrides.description: Per-DJ presentation overrides for a (dimension, value): a chip colour and/or short label. Presentation ONLY - never hashed, unreachable from the write path.

pathRules.description: Per-DJ filename/path ingest rules: read-time projection of names/paths onto SDTS fields. Read-time only; never touches a canonical value or the stable hash.

match.description: Path glob this rule applies to.

codes.description: Tail-token mappings; also the recogniser (a trailing token is 'tail' iff it appears here). Absent = none.

on_unknown_token.description: What an unrecognised trailing token does (default Flag). Omitted when default.

set.description: Unconditional field -> value writes this rule contributes regardless of the tail.

plusRunRating.description: A trailing '+'-run rating extractor: '+++' -> a rating value on 'to'.

scale.description: How the plus-count maps onto the 1-10 rating family (default Clamp10).

max.description: The observed plus-count ceiling for the Linear scale (default 11).

yearExtractor.description: A year extractor: the first regex match in the basename -> 'to'.

pattern.description: Regex; first match in the basename.
